properties.title: Move autopilot switched to ai-service provider

properties.title: Agent service rejects harness-as-provider configs
properties.summary: Added shared validation so harness names and aliases such as gemini-cli, claudep, codex, jules, hermes, and copilot cannot be used as provider values.

properties.title: Move autopilot switched to Hermes with ai-service
properties.summary: Found claudep through ai-service Anthropic compatibility produced literal tool-call text without executing tools. Added runner detection for that false success and switched Move autopilot to Hermes after a side-effect smoke test verified Hermes can execute tools through ai-service/auto-smart.
